856-3967-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

765-2645-3430-5475.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2645-3430-5475.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3175-3605-4247-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

728-3175-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1012-4871-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-4871-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
1012-4871-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2738-3967-4871-6887.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

792-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Totentanz, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

423-573-1437-2895.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1437-2895.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5320-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-5320-6291.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-5320-6291.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

3532-4928-5078-5645.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

6747-6867-7043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
6747-6867-7043.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1315-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
997-1315-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat
997-1315-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2946-4050-6351.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

856-2279-5776-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1305-4885-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1808-2438-6625.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

325-392-2275-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-392-2275-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

1283-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

1350-1355--85.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
1350-1355--85.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1742-2793-3743-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1742-2793-3743-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

3652-5220-5256-5683.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4871-5147-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2034-3372-3480-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-3480-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

128-1339-4509.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
There is at least one Insect on the battlefield.
128-1339-4509.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Elemental Bond triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
128-1339-4509.notes: This combo will result in you drawing your library, and losing the game if it isn't interacted with. Ensure you have a way to avoid this before starting the combo.

24-1841-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain twice that much life.

560-2034-2308-2606-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fungus Beast and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

617-2179-3609.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Magistrate's Scepter.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Key's ability, untapping Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Magistrate's Scepter ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Resolve the Voltaic Key ability from step 4, untapping Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate Scepter abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat every other turn.

587-4557-5218.description:
Discard Eidolon to Dream Halls' effect to cast Loon.
Return Eidolon to your hand.
When Loon enters, draw two cards and put two cards on the bottom of your library and return Loon to your hand.
Repeat.
